responsibility: Implements LONGCOMPLEX mathematical operations as wrappers over long-precision complex builtins exposed through cbuiltin. It maps the ISO API onto cabsl/cargl/conjl/cpowl/csqrtl/clogl and related trigonometric functions, adds simple polar/scalar helpers, and provides the module’s exception-query stub for the long-complex math layer.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements the declared LONGCOMPLEX operations by binding them to cbuiltin long-complex routines such as cabsl, cpowl, and csqrtl, plus simple helpers; LongComplexMath.def only specifies that public surface.
